name: Text
description: Shows a text file: reads it through the preview bridge and draws it with the host's own colours, fonts and sizes. Read-only -- there is no edit button, because a plugin that can be edited is one the host grows a change screen for, and this one hands nothing over. It claims the plain text and source-file extensions and the empty extension -- a file whose name has none, like LICENSE or .gitignore, which no dotted spelling can name -- so a file of a kind no other plugin answers for is still opened as text rather than left blank.
